name: @nuri/rn
description: Nuri RN · the bare certified RN engine: theme runtime + createNuriComponent + the ergonomic 1:1 components. Consumes @nuri/spec (the frozen descriptors+tokens) through its exports map · decision 65.7/65.8.
//expo: `expo` is pinned ^54.0.0 even though the factory does not import it at runtime: babel-preset-expo declares `peerOptional expo@"*"`, so WITHOUT this pin npm floats it to the latest major (56), whose winter runtime crashes jest-expo's RN transform. Pinning aligns it with jest-expo/babel-preset-expo 54 (the Expo-54 toolchain). M2 integration · decision 65.8.
//react-native-svg: The icon contract (the DS owns RN glyph rendering): NuriIcon resolves a typed IconName → the register markup → react-native-svg's SvgXml. A PEER (the host app provides it · like react-native) pinned to the same 15.12.1 the expo-demo ships; mirrored in devDependencies so this package's own jest/tsc resolve it standalone.
